# Feature: Embedding Batch Boundary

The search index SHALL retain every scenario across embedding batches.

## Background

* The feature contains more scenarios than one embedding batch.

## Scenarios

### Scenario: Scenario 01

* *GIVEN* scenario 01 exists
* *WHEN* the search index is built
* *THEN* scenario 01 SHALL be indexed
